value.tellUser: I can't start Codex peers on this machine. Codex sessions need herdr, and herdr isn't installed here. So I'm starting two Claude Code reviewers instead, in cmux split panes next to yours: diff-review-a and diff-review-b. Each one is told to review the diff without editing any files and to send its findings back to me. I'll stop here until they reply. When they're done, both sessions will still be running, and I'll give you the commands to shut them down. If you specifically need Codex, install herdr and run me from a herdr pane.
